comments.author: @OdysseyDocs
comments.text: The world out there is beautiful, yet a human life is all too short. So, live a life truly worth living: travel more, gain new experiences, and focus on your work to earn the money needed to fulfill your own needs—rather than worrying about what others think of you.

comments.text: The courage of Maupiti's locals to vote against mass luxury resorts back in 2004 is so inspiring. They chose community and heritage over fast money, which makes this island truly priceless.
